decisions: Minutes from the June 18, 2025 board meeting approved as amended, unanimously.
Authorized Pierre Dubois to draw up to $500,000 from the existing credit facility if cash reserves fall below $800,000; financial update required at next meeting.

Dominic Ferreira designated as Dedicated Account Lead for Northwind Partners effective August 1, 2025; Aiyana Park authorized to hire one compliance consultant (budget up to $95,000 annually); Northwind Partners expansion proposal to be reviewed at October board meeting.
Approved procurement of CoreFlow Pro at a budget not to exceed $125,000; target go-live October 1, 2025; transition task force to be assembled by August 15, 2025.

Pierre Dubois to deliver revised compensation framework for senior and principal staff by August 20, 2025, targeting market-median alignment with up to $280,000 annual budget provisionally allocated; Aiyana Park to draft flexible work policy by August 30, 2025.

Approved attendance and Silver-level sponsorship at the Global Advisory & Consulting Summit 2025 (September 10–12, Toronto) with a total budget of $35,000; speaking proposals to be submitted by July 31, 2025.
